head: 80eab1c8c79ab23cd4fd9bf4122c19f2004ad6fa
title: fix(invite-codes): codes typed in lower case or without the dash pair on every signup path (HUNT-03-124)
body:
HUNT-03-124 (agent 124) — DAY-1 EDGE HUNT, invite codes and coach pairing.

## Problem (B-H03-1)
A client types the featured code from the Home banner or a coach's text as `gp-bradley` (or `GPBRADLEY`) on the sign-up screen: the
code check says it is not active and "Create account" stops with the invalid-code error, although the coachless Home sheet accepts
the same input. Codes are stored upper-case (`GP-XXXXXX`, owner vanity codes such as `GP-BRADLEY`), and every lookup outside the
coachless sheet was exact (`findUnique` on `CoachProfile.invite_code` / `InviteCode.code`):

- `InviteCodesService.previewCode` (sign-up screen check, `signupWithCode` pre-check, `/join/<code>` and `/invite/<code>` landing),
- `InviteCodesService.attachUserToCoachByCode` (the one writer behind `/auth/signup-with-code`, `/auth/google`, `/auth/apple`,
  `/auth/select-role`, `/auth/attach-invite-code`, `/auth/attach-coach-code`).

The mobile sign-up form (`CreateAccountScreen`) and the post-Google code screen (`RoleSelectionScreen`) only set
`autoCapitalize="characters"`, a keyboard hint: a pasted or shift-toggled lower-case code is sent as typed. Fixing it server-side
covers the store build, the 10-07 build and every path at once.

## Change
- `inviteCodeLookupCandidates(raw)`: trimmed form as typed, then upper-case, then upper-case with the dash after `GP` restored.
  Only well-formed forms are returned (a space inside a code stays malformed, so the existing "contains space -> no DB" preview guard
  holds). An exact stored code always wins; extra lookups happen only after a miss.
- `previewCode` tries the forms in order (body moved unchanged into `previewExactCode`).
- `attachUserToCoachByCode` resolves the first form that exists and then uses the STORED code for validation, seat consumption,
  the signup ledger and the package grant, so `gp-bradley` behaves exactly like `GP-BRADLEY`.
- README note in `src/invite-codes/README.md`.

No schema, no migration, no flags, no mobile change.

## Tests (failing first)
`test/invite-code-typed-case.spec.ts` (real InviteCodesService + AuthService over the stateful DB double):
lower-case permanent code preview; lower-case and no-dash vanity row preview; lower-case vanity attach (stored row consumed, ledger
records `GP-BRADLEY`); no-dash permanent code attach; select-role with a lower-case code; control: unknown code still refused, exact
code still resolves.
Failing first: ci-lane run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37523029032 on
32a0fcdf (test only, main code): 5 failed / 1 passed in the new spec (received `{valid:false}` and `invite_code_invalid`);
`invite-attach-idempotent-replay.spec.ts` passed. The lane ran the first draft of the spec, which also had two space-in-code
assertions; those were dropped (spaces stay malformed) and one attach case now types `gpbbbbbb`.

## Grade
T3 (decides which coach a client is attached to). Size 165 changed lines (3 files).
Overlap: stale open PR #587 (09-30) also touches invite-codes.service.ts, different hunks.
